image.alternateText: View of a Audemars Piguet boutique.

entities.cquoteBoutiquePages: Step into our AP House, an innovative and intimate concept that embodies Audemars Piguet’s forward-thinking approach to retail. Overlooking the historic Max-Joseph-Platz, AP House Munich invites you to experience Audemars Piguet’s craftsmanship in a setting that marries the city’s cultural legacy with modern elegance. Join us in this refined space where history and innovation coexist in perfect harmony. Join a community where genuine connections and a shared passion for fine watchmaking are at the heart of the experience.
entities.cdescriptionBoutiquePages:
Audemars Piguet’s forward-thinking approach to retail. Whether you wish to discover our watches, explore AP’s universe, or simply spend time with us, our doors are always open.

The result is a space where the comfort of home and the warmth of friendship take priority.

entities.cquoteBoutiquePages: Step into our AP House, an innovative and intimate concept that embodies Audemars Piguet’s forward-thinking approach to retail. Located in the iconic Garage Traversi on Via Bagutta, AP House Milan invites you to explore the intersection of heritage and innovation at the heart of Audemars Piguet. Discover the brand’s craftsmanship in a space where Milan’s rich cultural tapestry meets cutting-edge design. Join a community where genuine connections and a shared passion for fine watchmaking are at the heart of the experience.

entities.cquoteBoutiquePages: Step into our AP House, an innovative and intimate concept that embodies Audemars Piguet’s forward-thinking approach to retail. AP House London invites you to experience a blend of luxury and comfort in one of England's iconic Grade II listed buildings. Overlooking the prestigious Clifford Street, the 420-square-metre space offers a refined setting with a professional kitchen, a Steinway Spirio piano, and spaces designed for both relaxation and socialising. Join a community where genuine connections and a shared passion for fine watchmaking are at the heart of the experience.
entities.cdescriptionBoutiquePages:
Audemars Piguet’s forward-thinking approach to retail. Whether you wish to discover our watches, explore AP’s universe, or simply spend time with us, our doors are always open. 
Designed as a timeless space for lovers of the brand, the AP House was created in collaboration with some of the Manufacture’s most loyal clients, imagining how brand founders Jules Louis Audemars and Edward Auguste Piguet would deal with their clients if they were living in the 21st century, travelling the world and sharing their passion for beautiful watches. The result is a space where the comfort of home and the warmth of friendship take priority.
